title: Vikerkaar jõe kohal
topic: a rainy Saturday, colours and a rainbow

sentences.sk: On laupäeva hommik ja Tallinnas sajab vihma.
sentences.en: It is Saturday morning and it is raining in Tallinn.

sentences.sk: Taevas on hall ja tänaval ei ole kedagi.
sentences.en: The sky is grey and there is nobody in the street.

sentences.sk: Issi, milline ilm täna on?
sentences.en: Daddy, what is the weather like today?

sentences.sk: Halb. On külm ja puhub tugev tuul.
sentences.en: Bad. It is cold and a strong wind is blowing.

sentences.sk: Aga ma tahan parki minna!
sentences.en: But I want to go to the park!

sentences.sk: Hästi, aga pane selga punane jope.
sentences.en: All right, but put on your red jacket.

sentences.sk: Mari paneb jalga kollased kummikud.
sentences.en: Mari puts on her yellow rubber boots.

sentences.sk: Ta võtab kaasa ka sinise vihmavarju.
sentences.en: She takes the blue umbrella along too.

sentences.sk: Pargis on muru märg ja roheline.
sentences.en: In the park the grass is wet and green.

sentences.sk: Vaata, issi, see loik on suur nagu meri!
sentences.en: Look, Daddy, this puddle is as big as the sea!

sentences.sk: Mari hüppab loiku ja naerab.
sentences.en: Mari jumps into the puddle and laughs.

sentences.sk: Siis vihm lõpeb ja pilve tagant tuleb päike.
sentences.en: Then the rain stops and the sun comes out from behind a cloud.

sentences.sk: Taevas on jälle sinine.
sentences.en: The sky is blue again.

sentences.sk: Mari, vaata üles! Jõe kohal on vikerkaar.
sentences.en: Mari, look up! There is a rainbow over the river.

sentences.sk: Mis värvid vikerkaarel on?
sentences.en: What colours does a rainbow have?

sentences.sk: Punane, oranž, kollane, roheline, sinine ja lilla.
sentences.en: Red, orange, yellow, green, blue and purple.

sentences.sk: Minu jope on punane nagu vikerkaar!
sentences.en: My jacket is red like the rainbow!

sentences.sk: Pingil istub vanamees musta koeraga.
sentences.en: An old man with a black dog is sitting on a bench.

sentences.sk: Ta ütleb, et pärast vihma tuleb alati päike.
sentences.en: He says that after rain the sun always comes.

sentences.sk: Õhtul on soe ja taevas on roosa.
sentences.en: In the evening it is warm and the sky is pink.

sentences.sk: Issi, kas homme sajab jälle vihma?
sentences.en: Daddy, will it rain again tomorrow?

sentences.sk: Ma ei tea. Aga sul on kollased kummikud.
sentences.en: I don't know. But you have yellow rubber boots.

sentences.sk: Ma tahan veel ühte vikerkaart!
sentences.en: I want one more rainbow!

questions.q: Mida Mari ja issi jõe kohal näevad?

recap: On a rainy Saturday Mari goes to the park with her dad in a red jacket and yellow boots. The rain stops, a rainbow appears over the river, and Mari wants one more.
